import json, threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs, urlencode
from urllib.request import urlopen

stats = {"requests": 0, "authorized": 0}
class FakeXtream(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *args): pass
    def do_GET(self):
        u = urlparse(self.path)
        q = parse_qs(u.query)
        stats["requests"] += 1
        ok = q.get("username") == ["synthetic-user"] and q.get("password") == ["synthetic-pass"]
        if not ok:
            payload = {"user_info":{"auth":0,"status":"Disabled"}}
        else:
            stats["authorized"] += 1
            action = q.get("action",[""])[0]
            if action == "get_live_categories": payload = [{"category_id":"1","category_name":"Teste"}]
            elif action == "get_live_streams": payload = [{"stream_id":12,"name":"Demo","category_id":"1"}]
            elif action == "get_vod_streams": payload = [{"stream_id":13,"name":"Demo movie","container_extension":"mp4"}]
            elif action == "get_series": payload = [{"series_id":14,"name":"Demo series"}]
            elif action == "get_series_info": payload = {"episodes":{"1":[{"id":15,"title":"Episódio fictício"}]}}
            elif action == "get_short_epg": payload = {"epg_listings":[]}
            else: payload = {"user_info":{"auth":1,"status":"Active"}}
        data = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

sv = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),FakeXtream)
th=threading.Thread(target=sv.serve_forever,daemon=True)
th.start()
try:
    base = "http://127.0.0.1:"+str(sv.server_port)+"/player_api.php"
    cases = ["","get_live_categories","get_live_streams","get_vod_streams","get_series","get_series_info","get_short_epg"]
    for act in cases:
        qs = {"username":"synthetic-user","password":"synthetic-pass"}
        if act: qs["action"]=act
        if act == "get_series_info": qs["series_id"]="14"
        with urlopen(base+"?"+urlencode(qs),timeout=3) as response:
            data=json.load(response)
        if act=="": assert data["user_info"]["auth"]==1
        elif act=="get_series_info": assert data["episodes"]["1"][0]["id"]==15
        elif act=="get_short_epg": assert isinstance(data["epg_listings"],list)
        else: assert isinstance(data,list) and data
    with urlopen(base+"?"+urlencode({"username":"synthetic-user","password":"bad"}),timeout=3) as response:
        invalid=json.load(response)
    assert invalid["user_info"]["auth"]==0
    assert stats["requests"]==8
    print(json.dumps({"ferrari_rea_synthetic_xtream":"PASS","checks":8,"server_requests":stats["requests"],"real_credentials_used":False,"real_tv_test":False}))
finally:
    sv.shutdown()
    sv.server_close()
